def solve(case):
    round_scores = case["round_scores"]
    round_targets = case["round_targets"]
    forced = case.get("forced", [])  # may not exist, default empty
    history = []
    retained = []
    for i, scores in enumerate(round_scores):
        target = round_targets[i]
        selected = set()
        if i == 0:
            for idx in forced:
                selected.add(idx)
        remaining = target - len(selected)
        if remaining > 0:
            # get list of (score, idx) for indices not selected
            candidates = [(score, idx) for idx, score in enumerate(scores) if idx not in selected]
            # sort descending by score
            candidates.sort(reverse=True, key=lambda x: x[0])
            # take top remaining
            for _, idx in candidates[:remaining]:
                selected.add(idx)
        # convert to sorted list
        selected_list = sorted(selected)
        history.append(selected_list)
        retained.extend(selected_list)
    return {"history": history, "retained_indices": retained}
